review_comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 Thanks a lot for the fix! Ideally we want to fix the compare logic by using this common function https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/k8s-config-connector/blob/master/pkg/controller/direct/common/compare.go#L782, so we only compare specified fields, which is exactly the same as what you did in this PR, but it will also prevent deletion of other unspecified spec fields. And we actually don't need the  unit tests on individual field anymore.

It's up to you if you want to update this to use the common function, or if you'd prefer to let our team take over.

Previously, `compareRedisCluster` called `common.DiffForTopLevelFields`, which sorts the diff paths. `common.CompareSpecifiedSpec` doesn't sort them yet (we should fix that later). For now, could you sort the diff paths before the `for` loop? That way the Patch calls stay in the same order in _http_mock.log.
Let's remove this unit test. The controller should be tested by the integration fixtures test.

Can we use the original object `a.desired`, instead of the normalized one? This would reduce the noises in the _http_mock.log and would address the unit test TestGoldenLogAlignment failures in presubmit

Thanks @gemmahou, switched to `common.CompareSpecifiedSpec` as suggested: `compareRedisCluster` now diffs only the fields set in the spec, so unset fields (not just `clusterEndpoints`) keep their live value and stay out of the update mask. The custom endpoints patch and the per-field unit tests are removed; one test remains for the unset-`clusterEndpoints` case. `go test ./pkg/controller/direct/redis/` passes; I could not run the mock-GCP golden tests locally.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
